(i) XML repositories and data- warehouses can be used to store historical data, (ii) XML data can be queried using historical queries written in a standard query language (XQuery), and (iii) relational databases can be used for historical queries on XML data.
(a) XML is a suitable representation language for the storage of historical data in relational databases and (b) the XQuery language is suitable for querying such data.
